title: Four tasks, every must_run and verdict visible in run/tool output; terse orchestrator messages
plan:
# Wave 5 — dashboard settings page

Rules: each task in its own worktree; an independent supervisor verdict is required per task; merge only on ok=true.

## T1 — Settings route and layout
must_run:
- `pnpm vitest run src/routes/settings`

## T2 — Timezone picker component
must_run:
- `pnpm vitest run src/components/TimezonePicker`
- `pnpm tsc --noEmit`

## T3 — Persist preferences via /api/prefs
must_run:
- `pnpm vitest run src/api/prefs`

## T4 — End-to-end smoke for the settings page (after T1–T3 merge)
must_run:
- `pnpm playwright test e2e/settings.spec.ts`
